mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_logs ( user_id, request_type, model, latency_ms, success, error_message, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{requestType}, #{model}, #{latencyMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS request_count_today, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success)::bigint AS success_count_today, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success)::bigint AS failure_count_today, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0)::float8 AS average_latency_ms_today, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens_today, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens_today, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens_today FROM ai_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
